defense_news.title: US Army’s 8th Psychological Operations Group inactivated
defense_news.summary: The Army's 8th Psychological Operations Group inactivated as the service reshapes its PSYOP and information warfare forces to counter global adversaries.

defense_news.title: Arizona Guard first to field Gray Eagle 25M drone
defense_news.summary: The state will receive 12 of the unmanned aircraft systems by the end of 2029.

defense_news.title: Order to limit Starshield for Ukraine came from inside White House, sources say
defense_news.summary: The order to limit a satellite system used by Ukraine for battlefield communications and drone operations came from inside the White House.

defense_news.title: South Korean lasers down three drones in Army demo, Hanwha says
defense_news.summary: Hanwha Systems laser weapons shot down target drones during a South Korean Army demonstration, the company said.

geo_news.title: TİHEK'ten ilkokul öğrencilerine yönelik "İnsan Hakları Atölyesi"

geo_news.title: ÖSYM, İstanbul'da hafta sonu yapılacak sınavların ertelendiğini duyurdu
